description: Backs up and clears all Windows event logs.

fields.name: BackupDir
fields.label: Backup folder
fields.helpText: Where .evtx backups are stored before each log is cleared.
fields.helpDetail: Windows event logs are system-wide diagnostic records kept by Windows itself — not this app's logs. This script exports every enabled log that has events to a .evtx file in this folder, then clears the live log. If a backup fails, that log is skipped and not cleared. To put events back, open Event Viewer and import the .evtx file — the app does not restore automatically.

fields.name: CutoffDays
fields.label: Only clear logs inactive for
fields.helpText: Only logs with no new events for this many days are cleared.
fields.helpDetail: A log is cleared only when its newest event is older than this many days — active logs are kept. 0 clears every enabled log that has events (today's behavior). Windows cannot delete individual old entries; whole logs are backed up to .evtx first, then cleared.
